maya: Quick postmortem follow-up for INC-5423 (KV-cache eviction recurrence). Need concrete runbook + playbook edits and clear owners for remediation sprint. Link: https://intranet.redwood/postmortem/INC-5423 :eyes:
maya: Specifically: 1) triage checklist with exact commands, 2) mitigation flow with rollback notes, 3) escalation ladder and on-call paging thresholds, 4) add an automated detector for the eviction pattern. Please claim items + ETA.
sanjay: I'll own the runbook triage + mitigation steps. Will add commands and a short troubleshooting checklist. ETA Tue 2026-03-24.
tess: I'll validate commands in staging and smoke-test the mitigation flow once you post them.
evan: I'll write the escalation policy text and alert thresholds. Proposal: page infra when eviction signature seen 3x in 12h OR p99 increase >150ms sustained for 5m. I'll also suggest an automated ticketing hook. ETA Wed 2026-03-25.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-7933 and linked to postmortem: https://tickets.redwood/INF-7933 (runbook edits + alert spike).
mila: I'll allocate 1 dev-day in next sprint for runbook review and staging validation. Will follow up on PRs.
sanjay: Commands to include under runbook -> evidence-collection and runbook -> mitigation:```# collect recent runtime logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=45m | grep -i KVCache
# identify pod
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
# trigger local evict
kubectl -n inference exec -it $POD -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9090/debug/cache/evict"``` Also adding a note: if evict causes >1% 5xx in next 5m, rollback and notify infra.
maya: Good. Add exact commands and expected outputs so SREs can validate quickly. Also include a short checklist: confirm logs, check KV cache metrics, run evict in staging, monitor for errors.
sanjay: PR opened: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pull/502  adds checklist, commands, and rollback guidance.
tess: I ran the staging flow against that PR; evict succeeded and no errors in 30m. Left comments on small wording nits in the PR.
evan: Spiked an alert in Datadog that detects the 3x-in-12h signature and will wire it to create INF tickets + page infra using the regular escalation route. Posting details in INF-7933 when done.
mila: Reviewed and approved the PR, merging after fixes. I'll mark sprint allocation consumed.
(48h later)
sanjay: PR merged: https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/9b7c1d  runbook updated and small playbook added for KV evictions. INF-7933 status: in-progress -> ready-for-validation.
maya: Thanks. New follow-up: add quarterly runbook drill to verify the mitigation flow (simulate eviction in staging). Adding as checklist item in the playbook and a recurring calendar invite.
evan: Will confirm the alert -> ticket -> page path and report next week.
mila: Runbook merge + sprint time confirmed. Closing incident follow-ups once the alert wiring is validated. :white_check_mark:
